text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Bitcoin showing slightly more weakness at -1.9%, while the Fear & Greed index sits at 11—signaling extreme fear and declining sentiment over the past week. Bitcoin dominance has ticked up to 57.8%, suggesting investors are rotating toward the largest asset during this period of risk-off sentiment. At $73B in 24-hour volume, activity remains moderate, consistent with a pullback phase rather than capitulation or panic selling.
